votes.motion: Commissioner Wilkey - I would like to make a motion that we approve the Minutes for July 12, 2022, but add a section to 4.6.4 that indicates that the working number for rent for those units is $2.00 per square foot

Commissioner McElreath - I move that we approve File #5C22/CUP-000181-2022, a preliminary non-administrative conditional use permit and preliminary site plan to construct office/warehouse space at 4202 S. Riverboat Road, in Taylorsville, Utah., subject to the findings and conditions outlined in the Staff Report as follows: 3.8.1 Application complies with all applicable standards of the Land Development Code (LDC), City Ordinances, and City Staff and review agency comments, prior to final approval. 3.8.2 A minimum 100-foot no-build natural buffer, measured from the west bank of the Jordan River

Commissioner Quigley – I move that we approve File #SI22/SI-NCU-000252-2022, to expand the existing legal nonconforming use “storage (ministorage) facilities” and structures at 4930 South Redwood Road in Taylorsville, Utah, as illustrated in the development plans included as Exhibits in the Staff Report, as they may be amended to comply with the laws, ordinances, and standards adopted by the City
